# Native acceptance client images

<!-- Generated by make deps-sync; edit tools/depsync/image-inventory.md.in. -->

Current pins are generated from the acceptance Dockerfiles. The immutable image
and archive digests identify the executable clients. Bundled tools whose exact
versions are not declared in a tag are reported by native CI; a moving image tag
must not inherit an old, manually copied version claim. Passing native CI on the
updated PR commit provides qualification evidence. Historical reports retain their
original tested versions.

The Puppet image stays on Ruby 3.3 through a Dependabot entry of its own,
because the pinned Puppet cannot extract a module archive on Ruby 3.4
([#1126](https://github.com/weaveplatform/artifactweave/issues/1126)). The
npm 12 image stays on Node 24 LTS the same way: it keeps the prior Node line
beside the newest Node ([decision 0034](../research/decisions/0034-npm.md)).

Purposeful compatibility lanes retain their declared runtimes. Updating a pin
regenerates this inventory, recipe labels and secondary version assertions; it
does not bypass native tests or the review required for acceptance client changes.
[QUAL-01 #792](https://github.com/weaveplatform/artifactweave/issues/792) records
the final merged-main qualification. See [dependency maintenance](dependency-maintenance.md).
